review_candidates.description: Ruolo: Network Operations Engineer RX Luogo: Milano/Roma/Napoli/Torino (Ibrido) ALTEN supporta le strategie di sviluppo dei propri clienti nelle aree dell’innovazione, della R&D e dei sistemi informativi tecnologici. Nato più di 30 anni fa e presente in 30 Paesi, il Gruppo ALTEN si è affermato come leader mondiale nell’ingegneria e nei Servizi IT e leader Europeo per la consulenza nell'industria Life Sciences. Lavoriamo con attori chiave nei settori: Aeronautico & Spaziale, della Difesa & Navale, della Sicurezza, Automobilistico, Ferroviario, dell’Energia, del Life Sciences, Finanziario, del Retail e dei Servizi. Con un fatturato di oltre 4.069 miliardi di euro, abbiamo attualmente più di 57.400 collaboratori in tutto il mondo. In Italia siamo presenti in 13 città lungo tutto il territorio nazionale: Torino, Milano, Gallarate, Brescia, Genova, La Spezia, Modena, Maranello, Bologna, Firenze, Roma, Napoli e Bari. Di cosa ti occuperai: Gestire e monitorare reti Radio Access Network (RAN) multi-vendor, con particolare focus su tecnologie Huawei e Nokia. Eseguire attività di troubleshooting avanzato su reti GSM, LTE e 5G, analizzando KPI, allarmi e performance di rete. Gestire attività operative di secondo livello (L2) relative a guasti, degradi prestazionali e segnalazioni provenienti dai sistemi di monitoraggio. Pianificare e supportare attività di rollout, upgrade software e modifiche configurative su rete mobile. Collaborare con i vendor e con i team di Engineering, Optimization e Field Operations per la risoluzione delle problematiche tecniche. Garantire il rispetto degli SLA e il mantenimento della qualità del servizio. Requisiti: Esperienza di almeno 5 anni in ambito Network Operations o RAN Operations. Conoscenza approfondita delle reti mobili GSM, LTE e 5G. Esperienza operativa su apparati Huawei e Nokia. Competenze di troubleshooting e analisi KPI radio. Esperienza nella gestione di attività di secondo livello (L2). Capacità di lavorare in contesti complessi e multi-vendor. Nice to Have: Esperienza su sistemi OSS e piattaforme di monitoraggio RAN. Esperienza in attività di ottimizzazione radio. Certificazioni vendor Huawei o Nokia. Formazione: Laurea preferibile, ma valutiamo anche candidati con diploma e esperienza consolidata . La retribuzione annua lorda per questo ruolo è compresa tra 35.000 EUR e 46.000 EUR . La posizione è inquadrata nell’ambito del CCNL del Commercio e Terziario applicato da ALTEN. Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in base alle competenze tecniche, all'esperienza specifica nel ruolo e agli esiti del processo di selezione, secondo criteri oggettivi e predefiniti. In presenza di profili con caratteristiche eccezionali rispetto al range indicato, una revisione potrà essere valutata previa approvazione interna. Il ruolo prevede l’integrazione dei principi di sicurezza delle informazioni nelle attività quotidiane, con attenzione alle policy aziendali. Include la gestione sicura di credenziali e strumenti, l’identificazione dei rischi e la segnalazione di incidenti. Verrà fornito il supporto necessario per consolidare queste competenze. Perché scegliere ALTEN? Technological challenges Crediamo che la tecnologia abbia un grande potenziale per migliorare il nostro futuro, per questo ricerchiamo talenti che siano motivati a costruire oggi il mondo di domani. Con il nostro portfolio clienti e i diversi progetti di R&D attivi, in ALTEN avrai modo di lavorare su progetti all'avanguardia. La nostra Technical Direction ti accompagnerà e indirizzerà durante il tuo percorso. Avrai la possibilità di metterti alla prova in contesti progettuali diversi e di confrontarti con esperti del settore per ampliare sempre più le tue conoscenze. Potrai unire le tue passioni e metterti in gioco professionalmente. Accetti la sfida? Inspiring Togetherness Ci impegniamo a favorire un ambiente di lavoro sereno e collaborativo organizzando attività di team building, iniziative di aggregazione, eventi sportivi, per conoscerci meglio e condividere momenti insieme. Il successo di un gruppo si fonda sulla cooperazione e condivisione reciproca del sapere e degli interessi. Fulfilling Opportunities In ALTEN troverai corsi formativi all’avanguardia per accrescere le tue competenze sia tecnologiche, sia linguistiche! Tramite ALTEN Academy potrai ottenere certificazioni con alcuni dei più importanti schemi internazionali come IREB®, ISTQB® e altri. Attraverso Aula Streaming, invece, avrai accesso a corsi di formazione più trasversali relativi a soft skills e potrai scegliere tra 12 corsi di lingua straniera. Sustainable commitment Crediamo che la tecnologia sia a supporto dello sviluppo sociale e della tutela ambientale. Oltre a collaborare a progetti che mirano alla sostenibilità, ci impegniamo a sostenere le cause che più abbiamo a cuore, avendo collaborato e collaborando, tra gli altri, con AISM, AIRC, LILT, Save the Children, Treedom, This Unique. Valorizziamo l'unicità e ci impegniamo a garantire che tutte le nostre persone abbiano pari opportunità all'interno della nostra azienda, fornendo loro gli strumenti per esprimere al massimo il proprio potenziale. Il nostro approccio alla diversità e all'inclusione si fonda sui principi di etica e integrità e rappresenta il fattore determinante per lo sviluppo di orizzonti di crescita personale e aziendale più ampi. Promuoviamo l'inserimento e l'integrazione lavorativa delle persone appartenenti alle categorie protette - in base a quanto disciplinato dalla legge 68/99. I prossimi step Una volta ricevuto il tuo cv, ci prenderemo il tempo necessario per valutarlo attentamente. Se sarà in linea con questa o con altre posizioni aperte all’interno del Gruppo, il nostro team Talent Acquisition ti contatterà telefonicamente. L’iter di selezione proseguirà con un colloquio conoscitivo con l'area Business, un successivo colloquio più approfondito, durante il quale potrebbe essere richiesto un test pratico, ed infine un colloquio tecnico. L’ordine e il numero delle interviste potrebbero variare a seconda delle esigenze di selezione. In alternativa, saremo felici di conservare il tuo CV nel nostro gestionale per poterlo rivalutare per opportunità future. Operando in 13 diverse città e altrettanti settori, potrebbero contattarti più Talent Acquisition Partner e/o più Business Manager, se riterranno che il tuo profilo sia in linea con i progetti e le necessità che stanno ricercando in quel momento. Se dovessi identificare ulteriori offerte di tuo interesse e in linea con il tuo profilo, aspettiamo la tua candidatura per poterla valutare nuovamente. ALTEN opera nel rispetto dei principi di diversità, equità ed inclusione, che alimentano i nostri valori. ALTEN ha l’obiettivo di abbattere ogni barriera e pregiudizio, garantendo un ambiente di lavoro accessibile ed accogliente, valutando candidature indipendentemente da genere, etnia, disabilità (artt. 1 e 18, legge 68/99), età, orientamento sessuale, religione, stato civile, convinzioni personali e politiche, appartenenza ad organizzazioni sindacali, responsabilità familiari e background socio-economico.

review_candidates.description: HR & Administrative Coordinator Telecare | Full-Time | Fully Remote | 40 Hours per Week About Telecare Telecare provides nationwide virtual concussion and traumatic brain injury (TBI) care, connecting patients with specialized providers through a coordinated telehealth model. As our organization continues to grow, we are strengthening the administrative processes and infrastructure that support our team. We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive HR & Administrative Coordinator to support our human resources and administrative functions. This role will assist with recruitment, onboarding, personnel file maintenance, provider licensure tracking, payroll-related issues, marketing expense tracking, and ongoing administrative projects. The ideal candidate has experience in HR administration or a related support role and takes pride in keeping records accurate, deadlines on track, and processes running smoothly. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of responsibilities, follows through without constant reminders, and helps build consistent, reliable processes as Telecare grows. Healthcare or telehealth experience is not required. We value strong HR fundamentals, attention to detail, initiative, and a willingness to learn. Key ResponsibilitiesHR Administration & Personnel Records Maintain accurate, complete, and organized digital personnel files for employees and applicable contractors. Track and maintain employment documentation, including offer letters, employment agreements, required forms, policy acknowledgments, and other personnel records. Conduct periodic file reviews to identify missing, outdated, or incomplete documentation. Maintain employee information and assist with personnel changes, position updates, and employment documentation. Organize and maintain HR trackers, spreadsheets, checklists, and digital filing systems. Handle confidential employee information with discretion and professionalism. Recruitment & Hiring Coordination Assist with posting job openings and maintaining applicant and candidate tracking systems. Coordinate interviews and communicate with candidates and hiring managers throughout the recruitment process. Track candidates through each stage of hiring and follow up on outstanding requirements. Prepare offer letters and hiring documentation using approved templates and processes. Coordinate pre-employment requirements, including background checks and reference checks when applicable. Maintain a current list of open positions, candidate progress, and outstanding hiring action items. Employee Onboarding & Offboarding Coordinate onboarding for new employees, including W-2 staff and PRN providers, as applicable. Ensure required employment documentation, training acknowledgments, and onboarding checklists are completed. Coordinate with department leaders to ensure new hires receive the information, resources, and system access needed to begin their roles. Track onboarding progress and proactively follow up on incomplete requirements. Assist with offboarding procedures, including documentation, equipment coordination, system access notifications, and personnel file updates. Help standardize onboarding and offboarding processes to create a consistent experience across the organization. Provider Licensure & Documentation Tracking Maintain an organized tracking system for provider licenses, certifications, renewals, and applicable expiration dates. Monitor upcoming deadlines and send timely reminders to providers and leadership. Collect and organize renewal documentation and maintain records of license verification. Follow up on missing or outdated documentation and escalate potential compliance concerns. Assist with tracking state-specific licensure requirements as Telecare expands into additional markets. Payroll & Employee Support Serve as an administrative point of contact for routine payroll questions and reported issues. Document and coordinate the resolution of payroll discrepancies, missed hours, incorrect pay, and other employee-reported concerns. Assist with timesheet collection, deadline reminders, and payroll documentation tracking. Communicate with employees, department leaders, and payroll contacts to ensure issues receive timely attention and follow-through. Maintain records of payroll inquiries and their resolution while protecting confidential compensation information. Escalate complex payroll or employment matters to the appropriate leadership or payroll contact. Marketing Expense & Spending Review Review and track marketing department expenses to ensure spending is accurately documented and categorized. Reconcile expense reports, receipts, and supporting documentation against submitted expenses. Monitor marketing spending against approved budgets and identify discrepancies, unusual charges, or expenses requiring clarification. Maintain an organized marketing expense tracker and provide regular spending summaries to leadership. Follow up with team members regarding missing receipts, incomplete expense submissions, or questions about charges. Assist with tracking marketing-related expenditures, including events, sponsorships, travel, advertising, and other departmental expenses. Flag potential budget variances and documentation concerns for leadership review. This role supports expense oversight but does not independently approve expenditures. Administrative Projects & Process Improvement Support ongoing HR and operational projects, including personnel file updates, documentation audits, and process standardization. Maintain trackers for outstanding tasks, deadlines, and required follow-ups. Assist in developing and updating HR procedures, templates, checklists, and standard operating procedures. Identify gaps in existing administrative processes and recommend practical improvements. Help ensure recurring HR responsibilities are completed consistently and on schedule. Provide additional administrative support to the Director of Operations and leadership team as needed. Qualifications & Experience Previous experience in HR administration, HR coordination, recruiting coordination, or a similar administrative support role is preferred. Approximately two years of experience is ideal, but candidates with relevant experience and strong organizational skills are encouraged to apply. Experience supporting employee onboarding, hiring, personnel records, or employment documentation. Familiarity with payroll administration, timesheet tracking, or employee payroll inquiries is a plus. Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail. Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook, or comparable productivity tools. Ability to manage multiple responsibilities, monitor deadlines, and consistently follow through on outstanding tasks. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and take initiative without constant supervision. Sound judgment and a commitment to confidentiality when handling sensitive personnel and compensation information. A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and a willingness to learn new systems and processes. Ability to review expense documentation, identify discrepancies, maintain accurate financial trackers, and prepare basic spending summaries. Preferred, but not required: Experience with HRIS platforms, applicant tracking systems, payroll software, or employee management tools. Experience maintaining compliance trackers, professional license records, or certification renewals. Experience tracking departmental budgets, reviewing expense reports, or reconciling receipts. Experience creating administrative workflows, checklists, or standard operating procedures. Healthcare or telehealth experience is not required. Candidates from a variety of industries are encouraged to apply if they have relevant HR administrative experience and the ability to manage detail-oriented responsibilities. What Success Looks Like The successful candidate will help ensure that: Personnel files and employment records remain accurate, organized, and complete. New hires move through onboarding efficiently, with required documentation completed on time. Hiring activity and candidate progress are tracked, with consistent follow-up. Provider license expirations and renewal requirements are monitored proactively. Payroll concerns are documented, communicated, and followed through to resolution. Marketing expenses are accurately documented, tracked against approved budgets, and reported to leadership. Missing documentation, spending discrepancies, and outstanding administrative issues are identified and escalated promptly. Administrative projects and recurring responsibilities are completed by established deadlines. HR and administrative processes become more consistent, efficient, and scalable as Telecare grows.

Develop and maintain sell-in, sell-out, and stock (SISO) analysis by distributor, wholesaler, channel, and SKU. Monitor stock cover, overstock, out-of-stock risks, near-expiry exposure, and sales trends to support inventory and forecasting decisions. Establish standardized data requirements, formats, and reporting frequencies for external distribution partners. Analyze commercial performance by business unit, brand, SKU, channel, region, and key account, identifying trends, gaps, and improvement opportunities. Develop dashboards and performance analysis to support sales teams, district managers, business unit heads, and senior management. Prepare monthly business review reports, translate findings into actionable recommendations, and follow up on agreed actions. Automate data collection, validation, and reporting processes while maintaining data quality, governance, and clear documentation. Experience consolidating multiple data sources, mapping partner codes, establishing master data, and reconciling figures with Finance. Experience developing commercial performance analysis used by sales teams and business leaders. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy. Strong communication and presentation skills. Ability to translate complex analysis into clear business recommendations. Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills. Proactive mindset with a focus on process improvement and ownership. Advanced SQL and strong data modelling capabilities. Advanced Power BI or an equivalent BI tool, including DAX or equivalent analytical modelling capabilities. Experience building automated data pipelines and integrating multiple data sources. Strong understanding of sales performance, distribution analytics, stock management, and commercial KPIs. Hands-on experience with BI platforms, database tools, and data preparation technologies. Familiarity with CRM and commercial data systems. Ability to work with complex datasets and establish a single source of truth. Ability to identify data gaps, investigate discrepancies, and improve underlying processes. Ability to work effectively with senior management, sales teams, Finance, Supply Chain, IT, and distribution partners. Willingness to visit distribution partners and the field when required. Ability to deliver practical solutions quickly and continuously improve them.
